report.title: Username input not found
report.summary: The test failed to find the username input field on the ParaBank login page. The test was trying to login with a username and password.
steps_to_reproduce: Try to login with a username and password
report.expected: The username input field should be visible on the login page
report.actual: Locator.wait_for: Timeout 15000ms exceeded. waiting for locator("input[name='user']") to be visible
evidence: waiting for locator("input[name='user']") to be visible
report.suspected_cause: The username input field may have been renamed or moved on the login page.
report.next_action: Verify the username input field is present on the login page and update the test locator if necessary.
